title: 31 January 1964: Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
These were The Beatles’ two final shows for January 1964 at the Olympia in Paris, France. The group’s residency continued until 4 February.

The Beatles’ setlist contained eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1975: UK single release: #9 Dream by John Lennon
  • 1972: Paul McCartney writes Give Ireland Back To The Irish
  • 1970: Ringo and Maureen fly from Las Vegas to Los Angeles
